silent_choices.detail: rules.md does not specify the order in which the terms' lines appear in the output
silent_choices.choice_made: terms are sorted in ascending lexicographic (alphabetical) order
silent_choices.reason: an index is conventionally alphabetical, and sorted order is deterministic and easy for a third party to verify

silent_choices.detail: rules.md says 'line numbers' but does not state whether numbering starts at 1 or 0
silent_choices.choice_made: 1-based line numbers (the first line of the document is line 1)
silent_choices.reason: 1-based numbering is the universal convention for referring to lines of a text document

silent_choices.detail: rules.md says the characters .,;: are 'stripped from both ends' without saying whether stripping is repeated when several such characters stack at an end
silent_choices.choice_made: strip all leading and trailing characters drawn from the set {. , ; :} (Python str.strip('.,;:') semantics)
silent_choices.reason: this is the plain reading of 'stripped from both ends'; for document.txt the choice is inert since no token has more than one such character at an end
